main_text.l: miscuè Titum, Apollo, Sosthenem, LXX. discipulos, &c. Apostolos vocant. Quà de nomenclatione fusiùs, Salmasius, Casaubonus, Montacutius, Blondellus, Forbesius, & siqui alij de Ecclesiastica præclarè meriti antiquitate.

VIII. Septimò, hinc constat Paulive-rius fuisse quàm Barnabæ, salutare hac E-pistola Hebræorum Ecclesias. Siquidem illi quà Apostolo, ac præconi universali, & harum cura fuit. Quas ille pro concione totiens, in Judæa, in Asia, in Europa, Hierosolymis, Antiochiæ, Iconij, Thes-salonicæ, Ephesi, &c. officij ratione do-cuerat. Quas in ore, quas in corde perpe-tuò gestabat. Quarum plurimas vel vel exerat[?], vel confirmarat. Apud quas ma-joris longe authoritatis, Pauli quàm Barnabæ nomen, ipso fatente Camerone. Imprimis quando: necesse fuerit, bar-nabam scripsisse vivo Paulo, si scripsit, & illum huic fuisse superstitem, juxtà cum obscurissimis ignoretur.

page.notes: The first word of the page, "miscuè", is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The word after "vel" in the line "Quarum plurimas vel ere-/xerat" is doubtful: the line break is worn and the word could be "exerat" or another form. The page number "249" is partly worn, and it could read "245". The gathering mark "IX" at bottom right is uncertain. Some words in the scan are blurred by ink spots, notably "Pauliverius" and "creaverat".
